arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=20))
    print()

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
ws = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

rows = {}
for row in ws.iter(f"{{{NS}}}row"):
    r = int(row.get("r"))
    for c in row:
        ref = c.get("r")
        v = c.find(f"{{{NS}}}v")
        if v is not None and c.get("t") == "n":
            rows[ref] = float(v.text)

expense_rows = [f"C{r}" for r in range(11, 23)]
total = sum(rows[ref] for ref in expense_rows)

from collections import OrderedDict
cats = OrderedDict()
cat_of = {11: "Housing", 12: "Housing", 13: "Housing", 14: "Transportation", 15: "Transportation",
          16: "Transportation", 17: "Food", 18: "Food", 19: "Entertainment", 20: "Entertainment",
          21: "Savings", 22: "Savings"}
for r in range(11, 23):
    cats.setdefault(cat_of[r], 0.0)
    cats[cat_of[r]] += rows[f"C{r}"]

print("Per-category totals:")
for k, v in cats.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v:,.2f}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES: {total:,.2f}")
